result.headline: Most residents have no identified mobile site within 5 km, which is the likely cause of poor coverage [zone_overview][fix_rule].
result.explanation: Most people in Zone Z00072 have no identified site within 5 km [zone_overview][fix_rule]. Existing EE, Three, and Vodafone sites are within about 6 km and reach many residents with clear lines [existing_1][existing_2][existing_3], so distance alone is not certain. Terrain blocks the line to every site within 5 km for 37 people, making terrain a partial rather than zone-wide cause [zone_overview][fix_rule]. There are no Ookla tests in the latest quarter and data confidence is low, so the evidence cannot separate distance from terrain at the point [zone_overview][fix_rule].

hypotheses.explanation: Most people have no identified site within 5 km [zone_overview][fix_rule], but existing EE, Three, and Vodafone sites are within about 6 km with clear lines to many residents [existing_1][existing_2][existing_3], so distance alone is not certain.

Terrain blocks the line to every site within 5 km for 37 people [zone_overview][fix_rule], while existing sites still reach many residents with clear lines [existing_1][existing_2][existing_3], making terrain a partial rather than zone-wide cause.
There are no Ookla tests in the latest quarter and data confidence is low, so the evidence cannot separate distance from terrain at the point [zone_overview][fix_rule].

fix_plan.why: The zone's poorly served cells are 836 people with no identified site within 5 km and 37 where terrain blocks every site within 5 km [zone_overview][fix_rule]. [cand_1] gives 873 of the zone's people a clear line of sight, drawn from those poorly served cells [cand_1]. Data is thin: no Ookla tests in the latest quarter and low data confidence [zone_overview], so measurements should be gathered first [fix_rule].
assumptions: line of sight to cell centres, not a radio model
thin data: no Ookla tests in latest quarter, low data confidence
fix_plan.candidate_finding: Candidate 1: a new 25 m mast on high ground (132 m, inside the zone) would give 873 of the zone's people a clear line of sight (896 poorly served people in all; 4294 people reached in 27 of 45 cells checked).

review.reason: The plan correctly uses the zone's people gaining (873) from poorly served cells [zone_overview][cand_1], states assumptions, matches the fix type (new_site) to the zone's cause (no site within 5 km or terrain blocking) per [fix_rule], and flags thin data (no Ookla tests, low confidence) per [zone_overview][fix_rule].

limitations: Sites are approximate; antenna heights assumed; Ofcom figures are area-level; no Ookla tests in the latest quarter so data confidence is low [zone_overview][fix_rule].

critiques.reason: The belief correctly captures the tension: zone_overview and fix_rule state 836 people have no identified site within 5 km, yet existing_1 (4.2 km) reaches 730 people with clear line of sight, and existing_2/3 (5.9 km) reach hundreds more. The belief's qualification that 'distance alone is not certain' is well supported.

Evidence shows terrain blocks lines to every site within 5 km for only 37 of 873 people (4%), while existing sites at 4.2–5.9 km provide clear lines to many residents. The belief's 'partial rather than zone-wide' assessment matches the data.

Zero Ookla tests in the zone and low data confidence are explicitly stated in zone_overview and fix_rule. Without measured speeds, the evidence cannot empirically separate distance from terrain effects at the user level, though propagation modelling exists.

The plan correctly uses the zone's people gaining (873) and poorly served people gaining (896) rather than total people reached, and the fix type matches the zone's cause (new site with measurements first). However, it does not explicitly flag the weak data confidence noted in [zone_overview] (no Ookla tests in latest quarter, data confidence low).

The plan correctly uses the zone's people gaining (873) from poorly served cells [zone_overview][cand_1], states assumptions, matches the fix type (new_site) to the zone's cause (no site within 5 km or terrain blocking) per [fix_rule], and flags thin data (no Ookla tests, low confidence) per [zone_overview][fix_rule].
